item.description:
## Highlights
- **Secrets for agents**: secure credential requests on macOS, secret redaction in shared threads, and guest-message approvals. - **Review and approvals**: a scannable Review queue, keyboard navigation, Org-style snoozing, optional rejection reasons, and Request Changes handoffs. - **Editor and search**: optional Vim mode, AI revision alternatives, web link previews, reliable Save & Done, and faster ranked search. - **Agents and chat**: shared AI rooms, per-agent reasoning settings, configurable turn limits, warm OpenCode servers, DeepSeek and OpenAI destinations, reviewed file renames and trash, and persistent thread drafts. - **Automation**: TODO-state and pull-request triggers, overlapping scheduled runs, clearer stop reasons, workspace coordination, and opt-in attention notifications. - **Org tooling**: flexible capture datetrees, repeater cancellation, archive parent IDs, and priority linting. - **Calendar and meetings**: connected Google Calendar sync and stable navigation when transcription completes. - **iPhone**: Push to Talk and walkie-talkie approval fixes, voice selection, optional speaker routing, and notification fixes. - **macOS**: Dock and Cmd-Tab presence, plus fixes for navigation, bulk snooze, and launch stalls.
Includes reliability improvements for remote agents, chat synchronization, and test infrastructure.
